title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Risk-off, oil ripped, small caps bled.
Energy was the only shelter while 10-year yields topped 5% and CPI held hot at 3.5%, squeezing rate-sensitive cyclicals and leaving breadth at 33% advancers. With Polymarket pricing 96% odds of a 2026 hike, the tape is priced for tightening, not easing — hence the mega-cap-over-small-cap skew.

INDICES — VIX 17.2, above its 15.6 20-day MA. SOXX +0.29%, SPY -0.46%, RSP -0.49%, DIA -0.62%, QQQ -0.65%, IJR -0.86%, IWM -0.96%. Small < large by 0.40pp. WTI led cross-asset at +3.32% while TLT slipped -0.27%.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.2x (price down = distribution); QQQ near average while IWM ran 1.3x, also down — small-cap distribution. XLY at 2.3x on a -1.75% drop confirms selling; TAN 3.1x and XHB 2.4x show cleanup in rate-sensitives. Breadth diverges hard: only 34% above the 50-DMA, 52% above the 200-DMA, up/down volume 0.52, and 19 new highs against 85 lows — narrow mega-cap tape, not a broad rally.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +2.17%, XLB Materials +0.48%, XLV Healthcare -0.05%, XLRE Real Estate -0.12%, XLK Technology -0.29%, XLF Financials -0.32%, XLI Industrials -0.64%, XLP Staples -0.82%, XLC Comms -0.90%, XLU Utilities -1.20%, XLY Discretionary -1.75%. Top industries USO +3.32% and XOP +3.22%; bottom IBIT -3.64% and WGMI -4.01%. Flows contradict the price leaders: XLE saw no inflow while XLF +345mm (65p) and XLV +157mm (62p) took money, with XLY -526mm (6p) and XLK -432mm (8p) bleeding. Money is rotating into financials and healthcare, out of discretionary and tech — defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.10 signals real protection demand, and IWM's 4.42 print is extreme hedging; skews are positive across the board (SPY +10.5%). IWM sits below its 277.5 gamma flip, so dealer hedging amplifies small-cap downside. VIXEQ 36.2 versus VIX 17.2 is a wide gap — high dispersion, rotation tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +3.32% on top of 20-day +24.23% is crushing transport and consumer discretionary (XLY -1.75%), while the 10-year above 5% pressures long-duration equities. Dollar +0.18% and gold +0.33% rising together is the odd pair. Next FOMC is Sep 16, 2026; Polymarket prices 96% for a 2026 hike (+18pp in five days).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 48, neutral. TMO +4.53% on a microplate-reader launch, QCOM +4.25%, EOG +3.50% (UBS target to $183); best momentum XLE +5.35%, worst XLI -9.38%. JPM vol 2.4x with price +0.67% is accumulation; IHI 4.4x on -0.15% is not. Watch IWM (-0.96%, below gamma flip) and XLU (-1.20%, worst 5-day at -4.90%) into the FOMC.
